Ava (CS): Quick note — finished a pulse with FinServCo during onboarding. Captured several product asks that look like they could block renewal. Need a quick triage from product/eng. /cc @Marcus (PM) @Leo (Product Ops) :clipboard:
Marcus (PM): Thanks Ava — can you paste the raw bullets here? Any immediate renewal risk? :eyes:
Ava (CS): Renewal risk: yes, they said they won't sign until billing is mapped to routes. Raw bullets:
• Per-route billing visibility in console (they currently only see aggregated spend)
• Clear docs comparing Dedicated vs Private (security + network tradeoffs)
• Faster embedding refresh endpoint (current ~90s too slow for recency search)
• Onboarding checklist with sample SSO/KMS config + templates
Customer quote: "We can't sign until we can map costs to routes."
Priya (CSE): I already logged these in the onboarding form. Field priority from FinServCo: billing = P0, docs = P1, embedding = P1. I can attach the spreadsheet with session notes.
Ava (CS): Quick CSV export from the form:
```csv
customer,ask,urgency,notes
FinServCo,per-route-billing,P0,blocks renewal
FinServCo,docs-dedicated-vs-private,P1,legal needs clarity
FinServCo,embedding-refresh,P1,search latency
```
Leo (Product Ops): Can product carve out 15 min for triage to map these to roadmap items? I think per-route billing UI toggle could be an MVP. @Marcus are you free 11:30 PT?
Marcus (PM): 11:30 PT works. CS, please add usage samples and tag the items with estimated impact. Need ARR at risk and any telemetry to justify priority.
Ava (CS): Estimated impact: ~ $120k ARR at risk if per-route billing isn't clarified. I'll add a detailed handoff doc in Drive and tag with `customer_feedback:onboarding`. Marking embedding as `needs-EVAL`.
Sam (Customer): Thanks all — appreciate the fast action. For embedding refresh, 30s target would be ideal. Happy to beta test anything.
Priya (CSE): Noted — I'll run a reproducible job and add perf logs to the ticket so eng can benchmark.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: sync scheduled with product at 11:30 PT today. Meeting link: https://meet.example/sync
Ava (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. After the triage, please update the ticket with final priority and cc FinServCo before EOD so they can see progress.
